title: Zephyr: Rule 3 compression
description: Implement Rule 3 compression in Zephyr C. Acceptance: compresses link-local IPv6/UDP, passes test vectors.
notes: Reconciled stale IPv6/UDP tracker wording against controlling Rule Set Version 3: wire Rule ID 3 is canonical link-local IPv6 + ICMPv6 RPL DIO. Hardened Zephyr Rule 3 compression only: exact zero TC/flow match, fe80::/64 endpoints (including multicast rejection), ICMPv6 checksum validation before selection, zero DIO flags/reserved match, deterministic 312-bit/39-byte MSB-first residue, opaque option-tail preservation, atomic output preflight, and 22554-byte encoded profile ceiling. Corrupt/nonmatching packets preserve parity via Rule 255. Added focused standalone C canonical-vector, field-extreme, opaque-tail, nonmatch, checksum, short-buffer, and exact/over-profile tests. Validation: sanitizer-backed C PASS 1/1; Python Rule 3 PASS 16; Rust canonical/header/profile tests PASS 3; Rule 4 compression/decompression and Rule 7 regressions PASS 3/3; cppcheck PASS.
close_reason: Implemented and cross-validated current-spec Zephyr SCHC Rule 3 compression
